what.text: This page follows refugees from the State of Palestine that UNHCR counts, in all host countries combined, at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 48323 of these refugees.
Greece hosts the largest share, 22.9%, followed by Belgium, Iraq and Cyprus.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for this group, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2001 to 2008.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 1976 at 3200 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 428775, at the end of 2002, and was much lower by the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals of the refugees UNHCR counts, summed over every host country.
